root_cause.text: The `atmel_sha204a_rng_read_nonblocking` function in the `atmel-sha204a` driver omits the required decrement of the `tfm_count` reference counter in the error path when `kmalloc_obj` fails, leading to a reference count leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies the `if (!work_data)` condition to include `atomic_dec(&i2c_priv->tfm_count);`, which addresses the CVE description noting the need to "decrement ->tfm_count to avoid blocking future reads" upon memory allocation failure.
